sentences.text: This animal is a member of the crocodile-line superorder Crocodylomorpha and belongs to the family Dyrosauridae.
Remains were discovered within the Dukamaje Formation in Nigeria.
Some skull parts may also exist in collections from Mali.
Halstead named the genus in 1975, establishing Sokotosuchus ianwilsoni as the defining species.
Evidence suggests it was closely related to Phosphatosaurus.
Its parent group is identified as Phosphatosaurinae.
The creature inhabited the region between 72.2 and 56 million years ago.
It lived during the Maastrichtian stage in western Africa.
The subfamily name Phosphatosaurinae was proposed for these animals, but it remains tentative due to poor knowledge of their anatomy.
